create_dataset_subclass: create a subclass of BaseDataset that implements __getitem__ to return samples by index
init_processors_method: call init_processors on a BaseDataset instance to automatically build and register configured processors
prepare_batch_method: call prepare_batch on a BaseDataset instance to move a batch of samples to the correct device
load_item_method: override load_item in a BaseDataset subclass to separately load and cache a sample by index
format_for_prediction_method: override format_for_prediction in a BaseDataset subclass to format model outputs for prediction reports
